description: This file implements an AST traverser for removing dynamic indexing of non-SSBO vectors and matrices in shader code, replacing them with function calls for component access. It includes functions for generating index access functions, traverser class implementation, and specific removal functions for different cases.

classes.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that removes dynamic indexing by replacing it with function calls, handling side effects, and inserting helper functions.

methods.name: GetIndexFunctionName
methods.description: Generates the name of the index access function based on type and operation (read/write).

methods.name: CreateIntConstantNode
methods.description: Creates a constant integer node for AST.

methods.name: EnsureSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a node to a signed integer type if it isn't already.

methods.name: GetFieldType
methods.description: Returns the field type for vector/matrix components.

methods.name: GetBaseType
methods.description: Returns the base type for indexing functions, with high precision and qualifiers.

methods.name: GetIndexFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Creates a function definition for dynamic index access for vectors/matrices.

methods.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingTraverser
methods.description: Class that traverses AST to replace dynamic indexing with function calls.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Handles binary nodes during traversal, replacing indirect index operations.

methods.name: insertHelperDefinitions
methods.description: Inserts helper index functions into the AST.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares the traverser for another traversal iteration.
